title: How to (Accidentally) Spot a Baku Cabin Crew Girl. Tip #1
body: She flies for AZAL and the training was harder than anyone outside believes. Ask about the selection, because thousands applied and the number who finished is small, and she remembers every stage. The uniform is the visible part. The three months before the uniform are the part nobody sees. It's a sealed deal if she can still recite an emergency procedure word for word years later.
caption:
Tip #1 😭 AZAL crew, the suitcase by the door is diagnostic.

title: How to (Accidentally) Spot a Baku Cabin Crew Girl. Tip #2
body: Watch the suitcase, because it lives packed by the door permanently and it is packed better than anyone else's has ever been. Nothing is folded, everything is rolled, and there is a system she will explain if you ask and will judge you silently if you don't. It's a sealed deal if she can be out of the door in eleven minutes from a phone call.

Tip #2 😭 AZAL crew, the suitcase by the door is diagnostic.

title: How to (Accidentally) Spot a Baku Cabin Crew Girl. Tip #3
body: Ask about the routes and watch what counts as glamorous collapse. Istanbul is a bus route. Dubai is a bus route. The long ones are the ones people want and they go to seniority. A layover is mostly a hotel, a shower, and sleeping at the wrong time of day. It's a sealed deal if she has been to fourteen cities and seen the inside of four.

Tip #3 😭 AZAL crew, the suitcase by the door is diagnostic.

title: How to (Accidentally) Spot a Baku Cabin Crew Girl. Tip #4
body: Ask what people say when they find out the job. Everyone has the same two reactions and she has heard both several thousand times. One is about how lucky she is. One is a question about the uniform. She smiles at both. It's a sealed deal if a relative has described her job as "stüardessa" in a tone that carries a whole opinion.

Tip #4 😭 AZAL crew, the suitcase by the door is diagnostic.

title: How to (Accidentally) Spot a Baku Cabin Crew Girl. Tip #5
body: Watch the sleep. There is no schedule, there is a roster, and the roster arrives and reorganises her entire month including two things she'd already promised to attend. Her family has stopped planning around her. She has stopped apologising. It's a sealed deal if she can fall asleep sitting upright, anywhere, within four minutes.
caption:
Tip #5 😭 AZAL crew, the suitcase by the door is diagnostic.

title: How to (Accidentally) Spot a Baku Cabin Crew Girl. Tip #6
body: Ask about the passengers, and note that the good stories are never told publicly. There is one about a man and a bag. There is one about a wedding party. She will tell you two and keep the third. It's a sealed deal if the whole crew has a group chat where the actual stories live and it is fiercely private.

title: How to (Accidentally) Spot a Baku Cabin Crew Girl. Tip #7
body: Ask how long she'll do it. Two years was the plan. It has been five. There is always a next step, ground operations, a management role, an airline in the Gulf, and the plan gets revised every January. It's a sealed deal if she says she'll stop soon in exactly the same voice she used three years ago.
